dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Alright, let's test run the Pursina's Spike. Don't worry, I'll be over here watching you operate it.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Start the Pursina's Spike. Be careful of the dark mud and monsters, though, and prevent the stoppage of the Spike.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: #We can only initialize the Spike here. Careful now, {NICKNAME}, make sure they don't get damaged.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: If you want to start moving the device, just start the hot air balloon right up.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Be careful of the mud and monsters along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I hope you succeed in transporting the Pursina's Spike.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I'm quite sure there will be some serious effects when you activate the Pursina's Spike at the location where the Ley Lines vent out dark mud, so you must be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: We also need to collect some rock samples from The Chasm to get a better picture of some involved parameters.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: We cannot shame the good name of the Akademiya...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, those miners are surprisingly reliable. Their footing was incredibly stable as they moved the Spike from the camp to this place.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I do hope that things will go as well when they move the Spike further down into the tunnels.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: The dark mud keeps spreading gradually. This state of affairs cannot be allowed to persist...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Is there some way we can transport the Pursina's Spike without touching the ground?

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: *cough* I'm a little unwell, but I'm feeling much better now than I did down there in the mining complex.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: What on earth was that dark mud. I just touched it once by mistake, and it felt like my entire side went cold... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: I just hope there won't be any long-lasting side effects...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}! I apologize, but I need more time to finish the adjustments to the Pursina's Spike.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: How's the mud-clearing going? Well, I hope?

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Just give us a shout if you need our help with anything!

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: I just hope that the mud can be cleared out soon.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: *sigh* When can we go back to the way things were, with everyone going down into the mines together...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I suppose I've finally managed to help Khedive with this dark mud problem of his...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: #...Ah, {NICKNAME}, hello! How is your day going?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Now that I think about it, you truly have been a big help to me a great many times.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: The business with the Energy Amplifier, our observations of that special Ruin Grader on Tsurumi Island, and now again here at The Chasm.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Each time, it was always some kind of emergency or highly complicated matter, which was then resolved wonderfully by your presence.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Honestly, I wonder if it's your luck that's good, or if it is my good fortune bumping into you so often...

choices.text: So, how are those memoirs going?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Heh, I mean, I was just saying it ... I still have a long way to go before my achievements are anything worth writing a memoir about.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: What's more, there are still many research topics left for me to tackle... and the more I tackle, the more I'll be able to write in my memoirs.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: A such, I'm of the view that the later you write your memoirs, the better.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Do you mean to ask why I accepted his commission to help him out here at The Chasm?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Do you know of the Purbiruni? Khedive is from that school of researchers.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: When I was at the Akademiya, I received quite a lot of help from that school, and so you can consider this a returning of that favor.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I mean, it's just normal to have such relationships, right? And in any case, no one school of researchers can solve all problems by themselves. That's why there's a need for collaboration!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It is how we bond as researchers.

choices.text: Well, all the best, then. See you!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: All the best to you too!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Well, I'm hoping that things will turn out for the best, at least...
